question: Which company received final authorisation from the Reserve Bank of India to operate as a Payment Aggregator–Cross Border entity in January 2026?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Skydo.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Cross border payments platform Skydo has received final RBI authorisation to operate as a Payment Aggregator Cross Border entity.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Skydo has received final approval from the Reserve Bank of India to operate as a PA CB entity.**
 
• The licence allows Skydo to facilitate overseas payment collections for Indian exporters.
 
• Skydo had earlier received in principle authorisation from RBI in January 2025.
 
• Skydo__ 
 __
 
• Founded in Bengaluru
 
• Serves MSMEs, freelancers and startups
 
• Supports collections in over 30 currencies
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Payment Aggregator Cross Border__

 __
 
• A regulatory category introduced by RBI to oversee and regulate cross border payment collection services.
 
 
 
• Foreign Inward Remittance Certificate__
 __
 
• A document issued by banks confirming receipt of foreign currency in India for export transactions.
 
 
 
• MSMEs__
 __
 
• Micro Small and Medium Enterprises that form the backbone of India’s export and services economy.
 
 
 
• Mid Market Forex Rate__
 
 
• The midpoint between the buy and sell rates of a currency used for fair foreign exchange pricing.
